services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: When it comes to planning a successful corporate event, everything has to come together perfectly from the choice of venue to the room set-up, to the food to the service. At The 1620 Winery at Cordage Park, we’ve got all the bases covered. Our landmark rustic winery with its soaring ceiling, exposed brick and beams and antique plank flooring is an ideal venue for corporate events of all types and sizes from sales meetings and conference/trade shows to lavish client appreciation events. Your guests won’t soon forget their time at our one of a kind winery. And of course our dedicated staff is famous for going above and beyond to make sure every detail is covered. services.name: Tours & Tastings
services.desc: Looking for the ideal outing for your group of 10 or more? The Vintner’s Experience at the 1620 Winery at Cordage Park is a combination Tour and Tasting for wine lovers and those who are just curious about the process of winemaking. You will be hosted by owner and winemaker, Robert Mullaney for an insiders tour of the winery. Robert will take you behind the curtain of his award winning winery while sharing his vintner’s passion for all things wine. Your group will have access to our private barrel room where you’ll sample select wines tapped direct from our tanks and barrels.
